It signifies a woman who is dedicated to her faith and strives to live her life in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name "Kardawiyah" inspires a woman to be a role model of faith and commitment, not only for her loved ones, but for the wider Muslim community.
